title: SC calls for swift, thorough, impartial probe into killing of Basilan judge
summary: The Supreme Court said it will continue to work with authorities and closely monitor the investigation into the killing of Isabela City Regional Trial Court Branch 2 Judge Joseph Wee Sit.
